origin_semantics: user proposal: use a filtering-like bulk transform but merge exact-equivalent states instead of discarding them
candidate_transition: A_x^b(S): assign one boundary variable to the whole current quotient state, simplify every affected clause exactly, then canonicalize
merge_rule: identical exact states after A_x^b are one quotient node and their multiplicities are added
exactness_obligation: equal quotient states must induce identical future occupancy generating functions over every remaining variable assignment
composition_obligation: process later variables directly on quotient states without reopening merged assignments

captain_obvious_preflight.forbidden: candidate first materializes all 2^k boundary assignments and only then deduplicates
captain_obvious_preflight.required: candidate branches only current quotient states and merges immediately
captain_obvious_preflight.reject_if: candidate source contains an explicit full-boundary enumeration path used by the solver
